{{Quote|A holographic trap. Very sneaky. Very expensive. These slavers have better security than I thought. Did you see how I set the multiphase emitter to turn off the hologram?|Hugo Cutter|<ref name="Blaze of Glory (short story)">{{JournalCite|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref>}}
A '''multiphase emitter''' was a technological device. During a [[Raid on Gabredor III slave camp|mission]] on [[Gabredor III/Legends|Gabredor III]], [[Hugo Cutter]] used a multiphase emitter to turn off a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] disguising a trap filled with explosives and [[Mine/Legends|mines]].
